beats.headline: Højlund breaks Portugal
say: Denmark one, Portugal nil! Twenty-three shots, and a late winner at Parken.

beats.title: Costa saves it!
beats.text: Eriksen's penalty, after Renato Veiga's handball
say: Twenty-four minutes. Eriksen steps up, and Diogo Costa saves the penalty.

beats.top: Denmark fans when Costa saved the penalty:

beats.title: Højlund!
beats.text: On at 69 minutes. Andreas Skov Olsen sets him up.
say: Seventy-eight minutes. Højlund, nine minutes off the bench, and Parken goes wild.

beats.top: POV: you're Portugal. 56% of the ball. 2 shots on target.
say: Portugal had more of the ball, and two shots on target all night.

beats.hurt: 56% of the ball. 2 shots on target 😭
say: Denmark had twenty-three shots to eight.
Portugal kept the ball, and did nothing with it.

beats.quote: It's the worst match we've played in a very long time.
say: Even their coach, Roberto Martínez, said it.

beats.top: Denmark fans three days later in Lisbon:
say: Three days later in Lisbon? Portugal won five two, after extra time.
